title: 10-minute upper arms workout
creator: NHS
description: A short triceps-focused routine from the NHS 10-minute series: press-ups, close-grip wall push-ups, bench dips and kneeling triceps kickbacks, 10 to 15 reps each. It needs only a wall and a stable chair. Do the press-ups on the knees to make it easier or move the wall push-ups to a chair or the floor to make it harder. Warm up first with the NHS 6-minute warm-up (nhs-6-min-warm-up) and finish with the 5-minute stretch (nhs-5-min-cool-down-stretch).

items.note: 10 to 15 reps; knees down for an easier version
Close grip, hands shoulder-width or closer, elbows tucked; 10 to 15 reps
Hands on the edge of a stable chair, knees at 90 degrees; 10 to 15 reps

items.name: Triceps kickbacks
items.note: 10 to 15 reps each arm; the source uses no weight
